youtube_short.title: Co-Signing a Loan Is a $21K Trap
title_alternatives: The Co-Sign Trap Nobody Warns You About
1 in 3 Co-Signers Ends Up Paying the Whole Loan
youtube_short.description: You signed your name to help someone out — but co-signing makes you 100% legally responsible for their debt the moment they miss a payment. Nearly 28% of co-signers end up paying the full loan themselves, and one late payment drops your credit score 40-80 points. 38% of co-signers say it permanently damaged or destroyed the relationship. Next time, offer a small gift instead of putting your credit on the line. Follow for more money traps they never taught you in school. #finance #money #personalfinance #credit #moneytips

hook_line: You co-signed to help. Now you owe $21,000.
